author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Mine a Little, a fun and relaxing mining game developed by PotDev. Control your pickaxe with your mouse, smash rocks, and collect valuable ores! Upgrade your pickaxe, break tougher rocks, and unlock new mining areas as you work your way toward becoming the ultimate miner! Mine a Little will be available on PC (Steam) in 2027.
title: Mine a Little - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Man I Just Wanna Live, an MSPaint-noir visual nightmare game developed by JZPS Games. You play as Mia, and you wake up with a terrible hangover in your shabby apartment after a night of heavy drinking. To make matters worse, the guy you came home with is sprawled on the bathroom floor, showing no signs of life. Mia just wants to live, the least you can do is help her survive! Man I Just Wanna Live is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Man I Just Wanna Live - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the ‘Let the Righteous Judge’ Cinematic Trailer for Vindictus: Defying Fate, a dark fantasy medieval action RPG developed by Nexon. Players can get a cinematic look at the narrative implications of the dramatic world of Vindictus: Defying Fate. Vindictus: Defying Fate is launching on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Vindictus: Defying Fate - Official ‘Let the Righteous Judge’ Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay and more from Dragon's Tear, an upcoming dungeon-crawling autobattler that tasks you with leading a team of adventurers down 100 handcrafted dungeon levels in search of the greatest treasure of all: the legendary Dragon's Tear, said to grant any wish. Dragon's Tear will be available on PC via Steam in Q1 2027.
title: Dragon's Tear - Official Trailer
